Professional Summary
Data Engineer with hands-on experience building and operating analytics pipelines and data models across cloud data warehouses and orchestration platforms. Proven ability to design ETL/ELT workflows, implement transformation logic, and deliver reliable data products for analytics and reporting. Comfortable working in Agile teams, applying software engineering practices to data engineering problems.

Technical Skills
Python 3, SQL, Apache Spark, Airflow, Snowflake, dbt, BigQuery, Databricks, Agile, Git, Jira

Data Engineer, GreenGrid (Mar 2026 - Present)

- Built Apache Airflow DAGs for end-to-end orchestration, implementing retry logic, SLA monitoring, and alerting to improve pipeline reliability and reduce incident MTTR. (Airflow)
- Collaborated with analytics team to deliver near-real-time dashboards by optimizing upstream transformations and materialized views used by BI tools. (BigQuery, Airflow)

Data Engineer, Wipro (Aug 2025 - Feb 2026)

- Automated deployments and version control of SQL and dbt artifacts using Git workflows and CI pipelines, accelerating release cycles for analytics changes. (dbt, Git)
- Worked within Agile sprints to prioritize data deliverables, tracked tasks and defects in Jira, and collaborated with stakeholders to refine acceptance criteria. (Agile, Jira)

Data Engineer, Zentrix Labs (Jun 2024 - Jul 2025)

- Leveraged Python and Databricks for ad-hoc data transformations and prototyping analytics-ready datasets used by product analytics teams. (Python 3, Databricks)
